title: Herbal Crispy Dutch Tofu Skewers
description: A plant-based Dutch dish featuring crispy tofu skewers infused with herbal flavors, perfect for a solo dinner. This recipe uses unflavored gelatin and a tandoor for a unique twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the dissolved gelatin, olive oil, parsley, dill, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and tandoor spice mix.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the herbal mixture.
Thread the tofu cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers in the tandoor and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Flip the skewers halfway through cooking to ensure even cooking.
Remove the skewers from the tandoor and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the herbal crispy Dutch tofu skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
